result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

The difference comes down to whether you prioritize ease of use or affordability.

## My top 4 recommendations

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall experience)

# \$8.99

Per user/month, annual billing

- Very easy for employees to use.
- Shared vaults for teams and departments.
- Granular access permissions.
- Excellent admin controls and security reporting.

Best if you want something polished that employees will actually adopt.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

# \$4

Per user/month, annual billing

- Open-source software.
- Shared password collections.
- Admin and audit tools.
- Directory synchronization.
- Good cross-platform support.

Best if you want strong security without spending much.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

# \$2+

Per user/month, annual billing; plan dependent

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders.
- Security and compliance features.
- Good for managing employee access.

Best for teams with more structured security requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

# \$8

Starting reference price per user/month

- Password health monitoring.
- Phishing alerts.
- Centralized administration.
- Security reporting.

Best if you want additional employee credential-risk monitoring.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Pricing references checked against available November 2026 comparisons. Confirm current checkout pricing and plan features before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/the-6-best-password-managers-for-business-in-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd prioritize for a small business

Regardless of which one you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Employees can securely share company credentials.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Everyone has their own login.
3. **Access management\:** You can revoke someone's access immediately when they leave.
4. **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication.
5. **Admin controls\:** You can see and manage who has access to what.
6. **Audit logs\:** You can track important account and sharing activity.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more specific recommendation based on how your team operates.

**1\. How many employees need access?**

---

**2\. What does your company primarily use?**

---

**3\. What's most important?**

---

**4\. What passwords will you manage?**

[Get my recommendation]

My initial instinct: **1Password for simplicity, Bitwarden for value.** Those are the two I'd put at the top of your shortlist.
